how_customers_find_and_choose: Customers find places through the map listing, photos and reviews, and compare a few before booking

what_works_now: A clean photo and video gallery of real recent work, rooms or events shared on request
Clear written packages with what is included and not, dates and cancellation terms
Booking by chat or link with a confirmation message and a reminder before the visit or trip
A quick reply during the hours when customers ask, with saved answers for common questions
Asking guests and clients for a review soon after the visit or event
A saved list of regular clients told about quiet slots or new offerings, with consent
For travel and pilgrimage: written itinerary, documents checklist and a named contact for the trip
outdated_or_weak: Printed flyers and pamphlets as the main source of bookings
Verbal bookings with no confirmation or deposit note
Generic 'post daily' advice with no steady supply of real content
Discount-led pricing that attracts one-time buyers
Promises of services or places that the business cannot deliver
